title: 지하철역 이름 읽기: 서울역, 시청, 강남
objective: You can read station names like 서울역, 시청, 강남 and 종로 aloud, including [서울력] and [종노].
summary: Learners read Seoul subway station names aloud and practice their sound changes.

task.title: Read and say station names
task.line: Say each name aloud first, then choose, mark, or write the answer.

words.exampleMeaning: I take the train at Seoul Station.
Let's meet in front of City Hall.

letters.sound: [ch] with a strong puff of air: 시청 [시청]
ㄹ after final ㅇ sounds [ㄴ]: 종로 [종노]
역 after final ㄹ sounds [력]: 서울역 [서울력]
letters.as: Say 'Seoul-lyeok'. The l sound carries into 역.

exercises: Choose the real sound: ① 서울역 — [서우력] / [서울력] ② 정릉 — [정능] / [정릉] ③ 강동 — [가동] / [강동]
Does the ㄹ sound change to [ㄴ]? Write Yes or No: ① 충정로 ② 대림 ③ 을지로
Which station name has ㅊ? Choose one: ① 대치 / 대림 ② 잠실 / 청담 ③ 교대 / 충무로
Choose the English spelling that matches the real sound: ① 청량리 — Cheongryangri / Cheongnyangni ② 천호 — Cheonho / Jeonho ③ 성수 — Seonsu / Seongsu
answers: ① Yes [충정노] ② No [대림] ③ No [을지로]
① 대치 ② 청담 ③ 충무로
① Cheongnyangni [청냥니] ② Cheonho ③ Seongsu
